method_assessments.author: Hietarinta and Salo (2000)
method_assessments.location: PDF page 2, numerical methods; pages 3–4, terraces and finite-box/discretization checks
method_assessments.applied: Per-accepted-update relative energy changes at 1e-7 and 1e-9; persistence counts; neighbour-angle warning at 30 degrees. These reproduce a reported measure, not the original optimizer or stopping implementation.
method_assessments.not_completed: No perturbation-and-return experiment, independent same-state literature identification, or fixed-spacing domain comparison is performed. Nonstationary Q21 endpoints cannot establish local-minimum stability from a return claim.
method_assessments.verdict: Energy-only diagnostic evaluated; full published convergence/stability procedure not reproduced.

method_assessments.author: Sutcliffe (2007)
method_assessments.applied: Registered fixed-box energy and geometric comparisons; literature approximately 0.1% relative-energy accuracy shown only as context. Additional native residual/morphology diagnostics are supplied by the workstation supplement.
method_assessments.not_completed: Approximately 1% absolute bias and 0.1% relative-energy accuracy are reported estimates, not stopping thresholds. The paper studies Q through 16; it has no Q21 target field. No matching absolute-energy target is inferred.
method_assessments.verdict: Refinement consistency assessed on unresolved endpoints; stationary continuum convergence and reproduction remain unestablished.

method_assessments.author: Jennings (2015)
method_assessments.applied: Report actual grid spacing against the published 301^3, spacing 0.06 setup; export display-only n3=-0.95 surfaces and compare measured energies and residuals across our grids.
method_assessments.not_completed: The methods description supplies no equivalent normalized-force/maximum-acceleration cutoff. Knot/link preimage correspondence and identical-state energy comparison are not established; no published-stability pass is invented.
method_assessments.verdict: Method-informed diagnostics applied; exact published basin, spatial accuracy and local-minimum reproduction remain unverified.

project_threshold_provenance.purpose: Tighter preparation to distinguish domain effects from incomplete relaxation

registered_plan.title: Record Q21 results, assess author-specific numerical criteria, measure retained fields, and run deferred grids explicitly on CPU
registered_plan.new_branches_memory: reset conjugacy for both, retain source alpha and native restart phase
registered_plan.early_exit: Unchanged readiness/representation/boundary/line-search/resource gates; a plateau or comparative ranking does not cut the 80-attempt allocation.
registered_plan.literature: Each authors measure and purpose remains separately labelled. No residual gate is replaced by an energy-change rule. No new physical stability or perturbation-return claim.
registered_plan.supplementary_scope: Read-only regional/percentile residuals, energy components, surface visualizations and refinement comparisons before and after the two new branches. Missing inputs are explicit deferrals; failed hashes stop.

interpretation: All old gate results remain visible. Energy stagnation is distinct from stationarity; stationarity is distinct from perturbation stability. Display surfaces are not knot invariants. No alternative gate is substituted.
